name: Guardian of Faith
clause: When ~ enters, any number of other target creatures you control phase out.

needs.proposedSignature: effect `{ op: 'phase-out', target: TargetSpec | Ref | 'permanents-you-control' | 'all-creatures' }`; static `{ kind: 'phasing' }` for the printed keyword; an internal delayed phase-in at the controller's untap step
needs.semantics: Phase out each named permanent and everything attached to it: set `o.ext.phasedOut` and `s.ext.phasing` (both already exist in src/engine/characteristics.ts, where the visibility filter drops phased-out objects). A phased-out permanent is treated as though it did not exist - no combat, no targeting, no state-based actions, no triggers - and it does NOT re-enter the battlefield when it phases in, so no ETB triggers fire and counters, auras and equipment survive (unlike an exile-and-return blink). It phases in before its controller untaps during their next untap step. The printed `phasing` keyword is the same machinery driven at untap.
needs.cr: 702.26 (702.26b, 702.26e for 'phases out'; 506.4 and 603.10b for combat and triggers)
